cases.situation: My old manager Diane and I haven't talked in 3 years, since I changed jobs. Pathfinder, the booking tool our team built under her, was switched off this week. One day I'd like her advice on moving into product management, but I don't want to open with a favour.
cases.reply: Hi Diane, it's been three years, which went far too fast. I saw this week that Pathfinder has been switched off, and it took me straight back to our team building it with you. How are things with you these days? No rush to reply, I just wanted to say hello.
cases.note: Reconnect first and keep the future ask out of this message; once she's replied and you're talking again, ask for the advice plainly in a separate message.

cases.situation: 大学室友，毕业后五年没怎么联系了，当年宿舍里就她的书最多。今天刷到她朋友圈，说在成都开了一家书店。
cases.reply: 好久不见，一晃都五年了。刚看到你在成都开了书店，太像你会做的事了，当年宿舍里就你的书最多。店开得怎么样？不急着回，就是想跟你打个招呼。
cases.note: 不用为断联道歉，用一个具体的原因开头，再问一个好回答的问题。

cases.situation: Me peleé con mi amigo Diego hace un año por una tontería de dinero y no hablamos desde entonces. Quiero escribirle sin reabrir la pelea.
cases.reply: Hola, Diego. Últimamente me he acordado mucho de ti y espero que estés bien. No te escribo por nada en especial. Si algún día te apetece tomar un café, me encantaría.
cases.note: Sin reabrir la pelea; si responde con cariño, propón un día concreto en menos de dos mensajes.

cases.situation: 佐藤健太、2016年卒業です。高校のバスケ部の顧問だった田中先生に10年ぶりに連絡したい。自分も今年の春から中学校の教員になって部活の顧問をしていて、先生の口癖「最後の一本は丁寧に」を今は自分が部員に言っています。同窓会で先生のLINEを教えてもらった。
cases.reply: 田中先生、ご無沙汰しています。2016年卒業のバスケ部の佐藤健太です。10年ぶりのご連絡になってしまいました。実は今年の春から中学校で教員になり、バスケ部の顧問もしています。練習の最後に先生がいつも言っていた「最後の一本は丁寧に」を、気づけば自分も部員に言っていて、先生のことを思い出しました。先生はお変わりなくお過ごしですか。お返事はお時間のあるときで大丈夫です。
cases.note: 空白には一文だけ触れ、具体的な思い出と近況、答えやすい問いを一つ。お願いごとは最初の連絡に入れない。

cases.situation: I messaged my old uni friend Tom after three years of silence. He replied really warmly, said he's been meaning to reach out too, and that he's now living in Bristol, about 40 minutes from me.
cases.reply: So good to hear from you, and Bristol is basically next door now. Want to grab lunch on Saturday 10 October? I'm happy to come to you.
cases.note: When they reply warmly, suggest one specific day within two messages, or the momentum dies.

cases.situation: I went quiet on my friend Leah for about 8 months during a rough patch, she texted a few times and I never replied. I'm doing better now and saw her allotment photos on Instagram. I want to reach out without a huge apology.
cases.reply: Leah, I've been quiet for most of this year and I'm sorry I left your messages hanging; it was a rough stretch and I went to ground. I'm doing a lot better now. Your allotment looks amazing, by the way. Could I buy you a coffee soon, maybe Saturday the 10th or Sunday the 11th? No rush to reply.
cases.note: When you were the one who went silent, one line of ownership is enough. A long apology makes her comfort you; a specific reason and a small plan move it forward.

cases.situation: My cousin Aisha and I were really close as kids, when our Nani used to time us racing round her garden, but we haven't talked since Nani's funeral five years ago. No fight, we just drifted; she's in Manchester and I'm in Toronto. I saw on Instagram that she ran her first half marathon on Sunday.
cases.reply: Aisha! Just saw your half marathon photos, huge congratulations. It made me think of Nani timing us racing round her garden, and how you always won. It's been far too long. How did it feel crossing the line? No rush to reply, I just wanted to say I'm proud of you.
cases.note: Family drift gets the same shape as friends: the gap named once, one shared memory, one easy question, and no apology spiral.

cases.situation: 林姐是我第一份工作的带教，教会我写方案先写一句话结论，四年没怎么联系了。她在上海，我在杭州。今天在朋友圈看到她升了市场总监，想发微信恭喜一下，但不想显得像是有事求她。
cases.reply: 林姐，好久不见，一晃都四年了！刚看到你升了市场总监，真心替你高兴。到现在我写方案都还是先写一句话结论，这是你当年教我的。下次来杭州出差跟我说一声，我请你喝咖啡。不急着回哈。
cases.note: 恭喜本身就是理由，不附带任何请求；一个具体的回忆比一句“恭喜恭喜”更让人记住你。

cases.situation: My high school best friend Marco moved to Lisbon six years ago and we haven't really talked in about four. I'm in Lisbon for work from Friday Oct 16 to Monday Oct 19 and I'd love to see him. Messaging him on Instagram.
cases.reply: Marco! It's been about four years, which is ridiculous. I'm in Lisbon for work from Friday 16 October to Monday 19 October, and my first thought was you. Any chance you're free for a coffee or a beer on the Saturday or Sunday? No pressure at all if the timing's bad.
cases.note: A trip to their city is a natural reason to reach out: name the gap once, give the specific days, and make no an easy answer.

cases.situation: Ich habe meiner alten Mitbewohnerin Katrin nach drei Jahren Funkstille geschrieben. Sie hat nur kurz geantwortet: 'Hey, lange nicht gehört! Alles gut hier, und bei dir?' Ich wohne seit März in Leipzig und arbeite in einer Buchhandlung; früher hat sie sonntags immer Pfannkuchen gemacht, und inzwischen mache ich selbst welche. Ich weiß nicht, ob sie überhaupt Lust auf Kontakt hat.
cases.reply: Bei mir alles gut, danke! Ich wohne seit März in Leipzig und arbeite jetzt in einer Buchhandlung, was mir erstaunlich gut gefällt. Machst du eigentlich noch deine Sonntagspfannkuchen? Ich denke jedes Mal an dich, wenn ich welche mache.
cases.note: Eine kurze Antwort ist kein Nein: Länge spiegeln, ein konkretes Detail, eine leichte Frage. Antwortet sie wärmer, im nächsten Schritt ein konkretes Telefonat oder Treffen vorschlagen.

cases.situation: 高中时我们五个女生有个微信群叫“三班五朵金花”，已经两年没人说话了。今天翻到高三运动会我们五个穿同款红T恤的照片。国庆我回南京待到10月6号，想在群里冒个泡，看大家有没有空聚一下。
cases.reply: 姐妹们，这个群安静两年了，我来冒个泡。今天翻到高三运动会咱们五个穿同款红T恤的照片，笑了半天。我国庆回南京，待到6号，有谁在的话，找个下午一起喝杯茶？不在南京的也说说近况就好，不急着回。
cases.note: 重启一个沉寂的群，一张具体的老照片比“好久不见”好接，邀请要具体，但不要求每个人都来。

cases.situation: My old college friend Nate's dad died about a year ago; he used to drive us both back to campus in his ancient car, singing along to the radio. I saw it on Facebook at the time and never reached out, and we haven't talked since. It's been eating at me and I want to message him now.
cases.reply: Nate, I've been meaning to write this for a long time. I saw last year that your dad had died, and I never reached out, which I regret. I'm so sorry, for your loss and for going quiet. I still think about him driving us both back to campus in that ancient car, singing along to the radio. No need to reply, but if you ever fancy a beer, I'd love that.
cases.note: Name what you missed once, briefly, then offer a real memory of the person; don't make him reassure you.

cases.situation: 大学好友阿琪三年前突然不回我消息了，我发过几次都没回，也没吵过架。刚听同学小敏说她回了厦门，还生了个女儿；前几天我还翻到大三我们去鼓浪屿拍的那卷胶片。我想再联系一次，但不想显得像在质问她。
cases.reply: 阿琪，好久不见！听小敏说你回厦门了，还当了妈妈，恭喜恭喜。前几天整理东西翻到咱们大三去鼓浪屿拍的那卷胶片，真怀念那时候。宝宝叫什么名字呀？不急着回，就是想你了。
cases.note: 先沉默的是对方时，完全不提那几年，也不问为什么；她还是不回，就不要再追。

cases.situation: I'm Emma. At 16 I did an exchange year in Lyon with Claire and Philippe Moreau and their son Julien; 12 years ago now. We swapped Christmas cards for a while, then stopped. I just found that year's photo album in my parents' attic, including one of Julien and me covered in flour, and want to email them; their English is good.
cases.reply:
Dear Claire and Philippe, it's been far too long since my last Christmas card. I was clearing out my parents' attic this weekend and found the album from my year with you, including the photo of Julien and me covered in flour in your kitchen. How are you all, and what is Julien up to these days? No rush at all to reply, I just wanted to say hello.
With love,
Emma
cases.note: A host family or anyone who once looked after you: name the gap once, one vivid shared memory, one easy question, no apology spiral.

cases.situation: My friend Jas and I were inseparable in our twenties; we closed down the Thai place on Mill Street on her 30th. Then I had twins three years ago and cancelled on her so often that she stopped asking; we haven't talked in over a year. I walked past that place yesterday, and the twins start preschool next week, so I finally have free mornings.
cases.reply: Jas, it's been over a year, and I know I was the one who kept cancelling, so that's on me. I walked past the Thai place on Mill Street yesterday and remembered us closing it down on your 30th. The twins start preschool next week, which means actual free mornings for the first time in three years. Could I buy you breakfast one day the week after? No pressure, and no rush to reply.
cases.note: When your life stage caused the drift, one line of ownership, then a plan small enough that you'll actually keep it this time.

cases.situation: 我叫林悦。大学摄影社的学长周航比我高两届，我们只一起去拍过几次外景，毕业后八年没联系，他可能都不记得我了。我刚搬到深圳，看他朋友圈也在深圳，想跟他打个招呼。
cases.reply: 周航学长好，不知道你还记不记得我，我是摄影社比你低两届的林悦，以前跟你们一起去拍过几次外景。一晃八年没联系了。我刚搬来深圳，看到你也在这边，就想打个招呼。你觉得深圳周末有什么值得去拍的地方吗？不急着回。
cases.note: 对方可能不记得你时，第一句先帮他想起你是谁，再问一个他好回答、又能聊下去的问题。

cases.situation: I'm Hannah. Mrs. Hughes, now 84, was our neighbour when I was a kid; she had me over after school and taught me to make scones. We moved away 15 years ago and lost touch. I'm writing her a letter by post: my mum has her address in Cardiff, I made her scone recipe last week, and I had my first baby, Ellie, in August.
cases.reply: Dear Mrs. Hughes, It's been about fifteen years, which is far too long. I made your scones last week and thought of you, so I wanted to write. My big news is that I had a baby girl, Ellie, in August. How are you keeping, and are you still baking? No rush at all to write back. With love, Hannah
cases.note: A paper letter to an older person can carry a little more warmth, but the shape is the same: one memory, one question, no pressure.

cases.situation: I texted my old friend Priya after three years; we drifted when I moved to Leeds, no fight, and I mentioned I still think about our Thursday choir nights. She replied: 'Oh, so now you remember I exist?' I think she's half joking but a bit hurt.
cases.reply: Ha, fair, I earned that one. I moved to Leeds and got really bad at keeping in touch, and I'm sorry I let it slide. I've missed you, that's genuinely all this is. Are you still singing on Thursdays?
cases.note: A prickly first reply is still a reply: own the gap in one line, don't grovel or defend it, and hand her an easy question.

cases.situation: 我和发小阿斌从小在一个大院长大，他去广州以后快十年没联系了，没吵过架。上周回老家，看到院里那棵老槐树还在，想起小时候我们蹲在树下弹玻璃珠。我明年5月在老家结婚，真心想请他来，但十年没说话突然请他，怕他觉得我是冲着份子钱，我其实不收他的礼金也行。
cases.reply: 阿斌，好久不见，一晃快十年了。上周回老家，看到院里那棵老槐树还在，一下就想起小时候咱俩蹲在树底下弹玻璃珠。跟你直说吧：我明年5月在老家结婚，特别希望你能来，人来就好，千万别随礼。具体日子定了再告诉你。你在广州这些年怎么样？不急着回。
cases.note: 如果联系的理由就是请对方来婚礼，第一条消息就直接说明白，并主动打消份子钱的顾虑。

cases.situation: I was very close to my ex-husband Mark's sister, Jenna, but we haven't spoken since the divorce two years ago; there was no fight between her and me. I saw on Instagram that she's opened a pottery studio. She once taught me to throw a wonky bowl one Christmas, and I still use it every day.
cases.reply: Hi Jenna, it's been about two years, and I've missed you. I saw the photos of your new pottery studio and it made me smile: I still use the wonky bowl you taught me to throw that Christmas, every single day. How's the studio going? No pressure to reply, I just wanted to say hi.
cases.note: Leave Mark and the divorce out of it; this message is only about the two of you.

cases.situation: I managed Sofia at my last job until she left two years ago, and we haven't talked since. I'm now hiring a senior designer at my new company and she'd be perfect. I still remember her checkout redesign that cut our support tickets in half. Messaging her on LinkedIn.
cases.reply: Hi Sofia, it's been about two years, and I'll be upfront about why I'm writing now: I'm hiring a senior designer at my new company, and you were the first person I thought of. Your checkout redesign, the one that halved our support tickets, is still the best example I know of the work I mean. If you're curious, I'd love to tell you more on a 20-minute call; if you're happy where you are, no hard feelings at all, and it's genuinely good to say hello.
cases.note: When the reason is an offer rather than a favour, say it in the first message and make no an easy answer.

cases.situation: Sou a Juliana e quero mandar mensagem no WhatsApp para a Camila, minha melhor amiga de infância no Colégio Santa Luzia, em Recife. Não nos falamos há uns sete anos, sem briga, e nem sei se o número ainda é dela. Vi que a escola fez 50 anos e postaram fotos da quadra onde a gente jogava vôlei.
cases.reply: Oi, Camila! Aqui é a Juliana, do Santa Luzia. Não sei se esse número ainda é seu; se não for, desculpa o engano! Vi que a escola fez 50 anos e postaram fotos da quadra, e na hora lembrei da gente jogando vôlei lá. Faz uns sete anos que não nos falamos e fiquei com vontade de saber de você. Como você está? Sem pressa para responder.
cases.note: Diga primeiro quem você é e de onde se conhecem, para que um estranho com o número antigo possa simplesmente dizer que é engano.

cases.situation: 我和网友“老K”是十年前在一个网游公会里认识的，每天晚上一起下副本，我在公会里叫“小鹿”，但我们从没见过面。六年前游戏停服后就没再联系，只剩QQ。今天看到这款游戏宣布重新开服，想起当年他带我打通最后一个副本，那晚我们打到凌晨三点。
cases.reply: 老K，还记得我吗？我是当年公会里的“小鹿”，一晃六年没联系了。今天看到咱们那个游戏宣布重新开服，第一反应就是想起你带着我打通最后那个副本，那晚我们一直打到凌晨三点。你最近怎么样？不急着回，就是想跟你打个招呼。
cases.note: 只在网上认识的朋友：先用当年的称呼帮他认出你，一个共同的记忆，一个好回答的问题，不急着约见面。

cases.situation: My old flatmate Callum turns 40 on Saturday 3 October. We shared a flat in Glasgow for four years in our twenties and haven't really spoken in about six years, no falling out. I still have the terrible orange armchair we dragged home off the street together, and I want to message him on WhatsApp.
cases.reply: Callum, happy almost-40th! It's been about six years, which is daft. I still have that terrible orange armchair we dragged home off the street in Glasgow. How are you marking Saturday? No rush to reply, I just wanted to say happy birthday.
cases.note: A birthday is a ready-made reason: name the gap once, one shared memory, one easy question, and save any meet-up idea for when he replies warmly.

cases.situation: Four years ago I designed the logo and website for Marisol's bakery, Crumb & Co, when I was just starting out as a freelancer. We haven't been in touch since the project ended. I just saw on Instagram that she's opened a second shop; I'm still proud of that project, but I don't want this to read as a sales pitch.
cases.reply: Hi Marisol, it's been about four years since we worked on the Crumb & Co logo, and I just saw the photos of your second shop. Huge congratulations! That project was one of my first as a freelancer and I'm still proud of it. How does it feel running two? No need to reply quickly, I just wanted to say well done.
cases.note: Reconnecting with a former client works only if it asks for nothing: no 'let me know if you need a refresh'.

cases.situation: My brother Danny and I haven't spoken in four years, since we argued over selling Mum's house. My cousin Rosie told me he and his wife Kate had a baby boy, Theo, two weeks ago. I don't want to reopen the house argument; I just want him to know I'm happy for him and that the door is open.
cases.reply: Danny, Rosie told me that you and Kate had Theo two weeks ago. Congratulations, I'm really happy for you both. I know it's been four years, and I'm not writing to go back over any of that. I'd love to see a photo of him if you ever feel like sending one, and if not, that's okay too. No rush to reply.
cases.note: After a family rift, the news is the reason and the only subject: no mention of the old argument, and a tiny ask he can ignore without it meaning anything.

cases.situation: My university friend Dana came out as trans a couple of years ago and uses she/her; I saw it on Instagram. We haven't talked in about five years, no falling out. We used to play chess in the library basement during exam weeks, and I've just joined a chess club.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, it's been about five years, which is far too long. I've just joined a chess club and keep thinking of our games in the library basement during exam weeks. How are you doing these days? No rush to reply, I just wanted to say hello.
cases.note: Use her name and pronouns naturally and leave the transition out of it; this message is about the friendship, not a reaction to her news.

cases.situation: 儿子乐乐和幼儿园的好朋友豆豆以前天天一起玩，去年我们搬到苏州后，我跟豆豆妈妈王姐一年多没联系了，没闹过不愉快。乐乐最近总念叨豆豆，前两天还画了一张他俩在小区滑滑梯的画。我们10月10日周六回上海一趟。
cases.reply: 王姐，好久不见，搬到苏州一晃一年多了！乐乐最近总念叨豆豆，前两天还画了一张他俩在小区滑滑梯的画，我拍给你看看。我们10月10日周六回上海，要是你们那天有空，带两个孩子出来玩一会儿？没空也完全没关系，不急着回。
cases.note: 家长之间重新联系，用孩子的一件具体小事开头，邀请具体又容易拒绝。

cases.situation: My mum was married to Leo's dad for six years, so Leo and I were stepbrothers from age 9 to 15; one summer we built a treehouse that took us all of August. Our parents divorced 12 years ago and we haven't spoken since, no falling out. I saw on Instagram he's running his first marathon, in Chicago, on Sunday Oct 11.
cases.reply: Hey Leo, it's been about twelve years, which is strange to type. I saw you're running your first marathon in Chicago on the 11th and wanted to say good luck. I still think about that treehouse that swallowed our entire August. How have you been? No rush to reply, especially mid-training.
cases.note: A former step-sibling has no default label, so the shared memory does the work instead of explaining the family history.

cases.situation: I'm Alex now; at school everyone knew me as Alexandra, and I came out as nonbinary three years ago. My school friend Hollie and I haven't talked in about seven years, no falling out. I just found the mixtape CD she burned me for my 16th birthday and want to message her on Instagram, where my profile shows my new name.
cases.reply: Hi Hollie, it's been about seven years, which is wild. This is Alex; you'll remember me as Alexandra from school, and I go by Alex these days. I just found the mixtape CD you burned me for my 16th birthday and thought of you straight away. How are you doing? No rush to reply, I just wanted to say hello.
cases.note: When your name has changed, say both names once, plainly, so they can place you; no need to explain more unless they ask.

cases.situation: 我叫周敏，是好朋友儿子乐天的干妈。乐天今年19岁，刚上大学读工科；他小时候跟我很亲，我在我家楼下教会他骑自行车。他12岁那年全家搬去广州后，我们只是过年通过他妈妈互相问好，已经七年没直接联系过了。他妈妈刚把他的微信推给我，说他会很高兴。
cases.reply: 乐天，我是周敏干妈，你妈妈把你微信推给我的。一晃七年没直接聊过了，可我一想起你，还是你在我家楼下歪歪扭扭骑自行车的样子。听说你开始读工科了，开学这几周感觉怎么样？不着急回，就是想好好跟你打个招呼。
cases.note: 跟长大了的晚辈重新联系，先说明自己是谁、怎么拿到联系方式，再问一个容易回答的问题。

cases.situation: My old uni friend Ruby lives in Melbourne, and we haven't talked in about five years, no falling out; in second year we shared a tiny flat above a chip shop. We're moving to Melbourne in January for my partner's job, and I'd love her tips on which suburbs to look at for renting. I want to be honest that's partly why I'm writing.
cases.reply: Hi Ruby, it's been about five years, which seems impossible. I'll be upfront: we're moving to Melbourne in January for my partner's job, and you were the first person I thought of, partly because I'd love your tips on which suburbs to look at for renting. Mostly, though, it would be lovely to have a friend there; I still think about our tiny flat above the chip shop. If you ever have 20 minutes for a call I'd be grateful, and if not, no hard feelings at all.
cases.note: When you need something, say so in the first message rather than hiding it behind small talk, and make no an easy answer.

cases.situation: My work friend Gemma was laid off from Harrowby Freight 18 months ago in the same round I survived, and we haven't spoken since; I never knew what to say. She's just posted on LinkedIn that she's started her own bookkeeping business. We used to do the Friday crossword together at lunch.
cases.reply: Hi Gemma, it's been about 18 months. I never knew what to say after the layoffs, so I said nothing, and I'm sorry for that. I just saw you've started your own bookkeeping business, which is brilliant news, congratulations. I still can't do the Friday crossword without wanting to ask you for help. How's the first stretch going? No rush to reply.
cases.note: When the silence came from not knowing what to say, one plain line owning it is enough; then make the message about her news.

cases.situation: 我叫刘洋，2014年在新疆当兵时的班长是赵磊，退伍后我们十年没联系，只留着微信。今天刷到他发的带女儿去天安门看升旗的视频。当年冬天站夜岗，他半夜给我们几个新兵送过热馒头，我一直记得。
cases.reply: 班长，我是刘洋，2014年在新疆你带的那批新兵。一晃十年没联系了。今天刷到你带闺女去天安门看升旗的视频，一下想起当年冬天站夜岗，你半夜给我们送热馒头。这些年过得怎么样？不急着回，就是想跟老班长问声好。
cases.note: 老战友、老上级：先报上当年的身份帮他想起你，再用一个具体的共同记忆，问一个好回答的问题。

cases.situation: I'm Sean. My old friend Kieran and I drifted about three years ago when my drinking got bad, and I missed his 30th after promising I'd be there; there was no big fight. I've been sober a year now, and I just saw on Instagram that he's restoring an old Vespa, the kind we always said we'd buy together. I want to reach out without making it a big amends speech.
cases.reply: Kieran, it's been about three years, which is far too long. I just saw you're restoring a Vespa, the kind we always said we'd buy together, and I couldn't not message. I'll say this once: I've been sober a year now, and I'm sorry I missed your 30th after promising I'd be there. How's the Vespa coming along? No rush to reply.
cases.note: Name the reason for the drift once, own the one specific thing, then hand him an easy question; the rest of the story can wait until he asks.

cases.situation: 大学时我在一个叫“末班车”的乐队弹吉他，鼓手是阿哲。毕业后他去了成都，我们七年没联系了，没吵过架。今天音乐App随机播放，居然放到我们大四录的那首《凌晨两点》demo，评论区还有人留言，想给他发个微信。
cases.reply: 阿哲，好久不见，一晃七年了。今天音乐App随机播放，居然放到了咱们“末班车”大四录的那首《凌晨两点》，评论区还有人留言，我一个人笑了半天。你现在还打鼓吗？不急着回，就是想跟你打个招呼。
cases.note: 老乐队队友：一首共同录过的歌就是最好的理由，再问一个他好回答的问题，先不提重组或见面。

cases.situation: Imogen and I were in the same evening writing class eight years ago and swapped chapters every week over cheap noodles; we drifted after she moved to Edinburgh. Her second novel is now everywhere, and she's doing a reading at a bookshop in my town on Thursday 15 October, which I'm planning to go to. I don't want to come across as a fan, or as someone who wants something from her.
cases.reply: Imogen, it's been about eight years, which seems impossible. Your novel is everywhere and I'm so pleased for you; I still think about us swapping chapters every week over cheap noodles. I saw you're reading in town on Thursday the 15th, so I'll be in the audience cheering quietly. How are you finding all of it? No need to reply, I know it must be a busy time.
cases.note: With a friend who's now well known, write to the person you knew: one shared memory, no ask, and an easy pass on replying.

cases.situation: I start a new job on the design team at Fenwick Labs on Monday, and I've just seen on the company's team page that my uni flatmate Priya is head of data there. We haven't talked in about six years, no falling out; in final year we survived exam season on her terrible microwave curry. I'd like to say hello before we bump into each other, without it looking like I'm after a leg-up.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, it's been about six years, which feels impossible. Funny news: I start on the design team at Fenwick Labs on Monday, and I've just spotted you on the team page. I'd rather say hello now than surprise you in the lift. I still think about surviving final-year exams on your terrible microwave curry. How are you finding it there? No rush to reply.
cases.note: When you're about to be colleagues, say hello before the corridor does it for you, and ask for nothing about the job; suggest a coffee only once she replies warmly.

cases.situation: 我和大学同学阿伟合伙开过一家奶茶店，2022年关门了，亏的钱两人平摊，没吵过架，但之后都觉得尴尬，三年没联系。开业那天我们俩在门口发传单一直发到天黑。今天路过原来的店面，现在开成了一家花店。
cases.reply: 阿伟，好久不见，一晃三年了。今天路过咱们以前那家奶茶店，现在开成了花店，一下想起开业那天咱俩在门口发传单，一直发到天黑。你最近怎么样？不急着回，就是想跟你打个招呼。
cases.note: 一起经历过失败的人：不提亏损，也不复盘谁对谁错，用一段好的共同记忆打招呼，问一个轻松的问题。
